messages:
marco: Figma link posted — new deploys flow focusing on canary preview + quick rollback CTA. looking for copy + a11y nits. https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (screenshot in frame 3). sasha: quick read: love the compact timeline but the small % pill next to variant name reads ambiguous. maybe label it 'Allocation' or add % icon. :eyes: lea: a11y check: screen readers won't announce transient canary updates. we should have an aria-live region for state changes. small example: ```
Canary allocation updated to 5% for v2
``` and ensure the rollback confirmation is reachable via keyboard and has clear focus. marco: good call — I was thinking aria-live polite. do we need assertive for rollback? lea: assertive for critical failures only. polite for allocation updates. rich (drew): copy: "Begin canary rollout" is too long in the action bar. can we shorten to "Start canary" or just "Start" with a tooltip? also the rollback button color contrast is low on the dark header — current fg #ff5a5a on #1f1f1f is ~3.8:1, needs >=4.5:1 for normal text. propose #ff3b30 or a filled pill. sasha: +1 to shorter CTAs. tooltip for "Start" seems fine for density. also variant chips need visible focus ring (2px solid #ffd166?). keyboard arrows should move between variants. zane: timeline: when there are >10 versions the vertical nav gets long. can we compress version cards to 28px and allow hover-expand? also add a lightweight search to jump to a commit id. currently the hover area is small and conflicts with touch targets. accessibility-bot: automated lint: - Missing alt text on deployment-graph.svg (frame 4). - Variant chips lack :focus-visible rules (9 occurrences). - Contrast fail on rollback-text in dark-mode (computed 3.82). marco: noted. i'll add alt texts and update focus CSS. next steps: - design: update CTAs, label pill -> "Allocation", add tooltip option for compact mode (sasha + drew) - eng: add aria-live status element and keyboard nav for chips (lea + zane to sync with runtime team) - ux writing: short CTAs + tooltip lines (marco -> sasha to loop in writing) can we get final mocks by EOD Thursday? tagging @drew @lea for dev handoff planning. :thumbsup: drew: can do. will check color tokens and push a small style update branch. lea: I'll draft the aria snippet and test with VoiceOver on mac. will post a short test script here once ready. marco: thanks all — will update the figma and ping when done. :sparkles:
